# Natal Notes

> Natal Notes Daily Journals: twelve hardcover journals, one for every zodiac sign, with an affirmation on every page. Find your real sidereal sign and the journal made for it.

## Journals

- [Aries Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/aries/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Fire, Cardinal, ruled by Mars. Tropical Mar 21 – Apr 19; sidereal Apr 14 – May 14.
- [Taurus Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/taurus/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Earth, Fixed, ruled by Venus. Tropical Apr 20 – May 20; sidereal May 15 – Jun 14.
- [Gemini Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/gemini/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Air, Mutable, ruled by Mercury. Tropical May 21 – Jun 20; sidereal Jun 15 – Jul 15.
- [Cancer Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/cancer/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Water, Cardinal, ruled by Moon. Tropical Jun 21 – Jul 22; sidereal Jul 16 – Aug 16.
- [Leo Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/leo/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Fire, Fixed, ruled by Sun. Tropical Jul 23 – Aug 22; sidereal Aug 17 – Sep 16.
- [Virgo Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/virgo/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Earth, Mutable, ruled by Mercury. Tropical Aug 23 – Sep 22; sidereal Sep 17 – Oct 16.
- [Libra Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/libra/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Air, Cardinal, ruled by Venus. Tropical Sep 23 – Oct 22; sidereal Oct 17 – Nov 15.
- [Scorpio Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/scorpio/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Water, Fixed, ruled by Mars (modern ruler Pluto). Tropical Oct 23 – Nov 21; sidereal Nov 16 – Dec 15.
- [Sagittarius Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/sagittarius/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Fire, Mutable, ruled by Jupiter. Tropical Nov 22 – Dec 21; sidereal Dec 16 – Jan 13.
- [Capricorn Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/capricorn/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Earth, Cardinal, ruled by Saturn. Tropical Dec 22 – Jan 19; sidereal Jan 14 – Feb 12.
- [Aquarius Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/aquarius/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Air, Fixed, ruled by Saturn (modern ruler Uranus). Tropical Jan 20 – Feb 18; sidereal Feb 13 – Mar 13.
- [Pisces Daily Journal](https://mynatalnotes.com/journals/pisces/): hardcover, 185 pages, an affirmation on every page. Water, Mutable, ruled by Jupiter (modern ruler Neptune). Tropical Feb 19 – Mar 20; sidereal Mar 14 – Apr 13.

## Sidereal horoscopes and guides

- [Rahu Ketu Transit 2026 to 2028: Rahu in Capricorn, Ketu in Cancer](https://mynatalnotes.com/guides/rahu-ketu-transit-2026-2028/): Rahu enters sidereal Capricorn and Ketu enters Cancer on December 5, 2026, and they stay until June 23, 2028. Dates, eclipses and what it means for your sign.
- [Virgo Sidereal Horoscope December 2026: Vedic Monthly Forecast](https://mynatalnotes.com/sidereal-horoscope/virgo/december-2026/): Virgo, December 2026 moves Rahu into your 5th house, turns Saturn direct in your 7th and peaks your career at the Full Moon on December 23. Dates, love, work.
